brand.name: Southern Biohazard Cleaning
brand.description: Professional biohazard and trauma cleaning, postmortem cleanup, high-pressure domestic and industrial cleaning, and property support services in Cape Town, South Africa.
brand.aboutIntro: Southern Biohazard Cleaning helps households, businesses and property managers restore and maintain spaces. Our services include sensitive postmortem and trauma-scene cleaning, high-pressure cleaning, deep cleaning and property support.
brand.mission: To provide careful, professional cleaning and property support with dignity, respect and attention to detail.
brand.vision: To be a trusted choice for specialised cleaning and reliable property care across the communities we serve.

contact.serviceArea: Cape Town and surrounding areas; other South African locations by arrangement

heroSlides.heading: Southern Biohazard.
heroSlides.description: Biohazard, trauma and postmortem cleaning delivered with compassion and care. Contact our team for discreet assistance.

heroSlides.heading: Sensitive situations.
heroSlides.description: We assist with specialist scene cleaning and restoring affected spaces, with respect for every family and property.

heroSlides.heading: From homes to industry.
heroSlides.description: Domestic and industrial cleaning, high-pressure washing, property turnovers, and intensive deep-clean solutions.

services.name: Biohazard & Trauma Cleaning
services.summary: Specialist cleanup following traumatic events and biological contamination.
services.details: Discreet cleaning of affected spaces, including deep cleaning and disinfection as appropriate. Contact us to explain the situation privately.

services.name: Postmortem & Unattended Death Cleanup
services.summary: Compassionate support when a loved one has passed.
services.details: Careful scene cleaning following unattended death and other postmortem situations, with a sensitive and respectful approach.

services.name: Hot & Cold High-Pressure Cleaning
services.summary: Pressure washing for residential and commercial surfaces.
services.details: Driveways, walls, roofs, forecourts, workshops, tankers and other suitable hard surfaces. We assess the surface before selecting a cleaning method.

services.name: Domestic & Industrial Deep Cleaning
services.summary: Thorough cleaning for properties, facilities and challenging spaces.
services.details: Residential cleaning, industrial workspaces, high-impact cleaning, deep cleaning and odour-control enquiries.

services.name: Property Management Support
services.summary: Cleaning and maintenance support for property owners and managers.
services.details: Move-in/move-out cleaning, property turnover cleaning, trash-outs, waste-removal enquiries and general property support.

services.name: E-Waste Removal & Trash-Outs
services.summary: Support with clearing unwanted items and property waste.
services.details: Ask about removal of old electronics, accumulated household items and cleaning associated with property turnovers. Disposal requirements depend on material and location.

faqs.question: Are you available for urgent postmortem cleaning?
faqs.answer: Our material advertises 24-hour postmortem cleaning services. Phone or WhatsApp us on 072 263 3533 to discuss immediate availability and the situation.

faqs.question: Which areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: Cape Town and surrounding areas are our main advertised service region. Please contact us to confirm service in other parts of South Africa.

faqs.question: Do you clean driveways, roofs and workshops?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide domestic and industrial high-pressure cleaning for suitable driveways, roofs, walls, forecourts, workshops, tankers and more.

faqs.question: How can I request a quotation?
faqs.answer: Call 072 263 3533, send a WhatsApp message or use the enquiry form. Share the service, location and any relevant details so we can assess the request.

faqs.question: Do you offer property move-in and move-out services?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our property support includes move-in and move-out cleaning, property turnover cleaning and trash-outs.
